title: GPARS Agent Capability Manifest
description: Machine-readable declaration of capability requirements for a general-purpose agent.

id.description: Unique identifier for the agent within its operational domain.

required_capabilities.description: Capability requirements required for the agent to function as intended. Capability IDs are manifest-local references and do not carry global GPARS semantics.

optional_capabilities.description: Capability requirements that enhance the agent but are not required for baseline operation.

extensions.description: Optional extension metadata. Keys SHOULD use reverse-domain notation to avoid collisions.

id.description: Manifest-local identifier for this capability requirement.

description.description: Human-readable, non-authoritative description of what the agent needs.
